audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text is sound (EVEN, 5.5/10 vs 47.82% WR over 3741 games) but the early-lane prose was written for a male enemy and hedges on when Charm exists.
audit.why: Ahri's lane is entirely gated on Charm (E, 12s flat) landing; Orianna has no dash and cannot dodge it, so difficulty rises the moment E is levelled and again at 6 with Spirit Rush.
audit.corrected: Early is Orianna's (auto-weave + Q-W on her step-up), levels 4-6 are Ahri's on Charm and Spirit Rush, two items flips it back to Orianna's Shockwave.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed level 6 doubles YOUR lane presence and that Luden's Q-W removes 'a third of a health bar' — a magnitude with no source, and level 6 belongs to Ahri.
audit.why: Spirit Rush is 140/120/100s with three casts per cooldown and extra recasts on takedown; that is the dominant level-6 spike in this lane, not Command: Shockwave (110/95/80s, 410 range, immobile caster).
audit.corrected: Lost Chapter steadies mana; level 6 is hers; Orianna's real spike is two items with a grouped Shockwave.
sources: brief.enemyKit R cd 140/120/100 text 'up to three times'

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were absent: Orb of Deception's return pass deals TRUE damage (stacking MR does not answer her), and Essence Theft heals her off minion waves and off takedowns (Grievous Wounds timing).
audit.why: Both are in Riot's own text in the kit file and both change what the player buys and how extended trades resolve. The page instead told the reader to 'decline politely' with no mechanism.
audit.corrected: State the true-damage return pass in spikes[0] and enemyWin, and put Oblivion Orb against Essence Theft into the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every third-person pronoun on the page was male: 'his combo', 'his farm path', 'his engage', 'his last-hits', 'his tower', 'His answer goes first'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists ahri as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so every he/his refers to Ahri and is wrong.
audit.corrected: All rewritten to she/her across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[0-2].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull, dontsFull and report[].

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].side read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Orianna while content win[N] read Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Orianna — five rows where the page renders two different answers to 'who wins this level'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart agrees with the content layer, and the kit supports it: no Charm rank early means Orianna's passive-stacked autos win 1-2; 12s Charm plus Essence Theft sustain wins 4-5; Spirit Rush wins 6 and first item.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved to Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Orianna with each flipped why rewritten to match the new verdict, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all, and dosFull[2].d called Charm 'the fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Charm is 12s flat at every rank; Spirit Rush is 140/120/100s for three dashes. Fifteen seconds is simply wrong and the reader steps up three seconds late.
audit.corrected: Charm (E), 12s flat; Spirit Rush 140/120/100s, three dashes per cast, and she cannot leave a Shockwave once all three are spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted verbatim under the title 'Burn R defensively when E already answers'.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed: the title promises a shield-versus-ult decision and the body talks about ball positioning.
audit.corrected: Command: Protect is a 9s shield; Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 — spend E on her burst and keep R for her real commit.

audit.why: Comet/Manaflow/Transcendence/Scorch with Biscuits + Cosmic Insight is a standard control-mage page and the Comet-rides-the-W-slow claim holds (Dissonance applies a slow).

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended with 'buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6' — a leaked line from another matchup, and no anti-heal despite Essence Theft.
audit.why: Zed is not in this matchup. Essence Theft is a real sustain source that Grievous Wounds answers.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb cuts Essence Theft; Zhonya's answers a Charm chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content spikes[2] and late both attributed her tempo to 'Electrocute burst'.
audit.why: A rune choice is not verifiable from the kit and is not guaranteed on any given Ahri; the mobility claim is verifiable and is the actual reason she holds tempo.
audit.corrected: Attribute the tempo to Spirit Rush's three dashes instead of a named rune.

audit.whatIsWrong: No patch-sensitivity statement anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Cannot be sourced from the kit files, and web research was not required to fix the defects above.

notes: Level chart: the full layer disagreed with the content layer on five of seven rows (0,1,3,4,5). The packet levelChart matches the CONTENT layer exactly, so the full layer was moved to it and every flipped why was rewritten in the same proposal; content win[0..6] already reads Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Orianna and needs no edit. phases[N].rating was deliberately NOT touched: the scale's direction is ambiguous and the two files disagree (here the Orianna-winning row 6 is 6/10 while Skill rows are 5/10, implying higher = better for you; on akali the Akali-winning rows are 6/10 and 7/10, implying higher = harder for you). See questionsForUser. Sides and whys stand on their own. Two missingInteractions rules were both landed: Orb of Deception's true-damage return pass (spikes[0], enemyWin, dontsFull[0].d) and Essence Theft sustain / anti-heal (ahead, breakdown.feeding, itemization). No web research was needed.
